answer: The mill house thunders with the waterwheel, and the gear pit smells of tallow. Proof of millwright via gear mesh tally — a gear the millwright meshes only after 36 gears turn true on the shaft, each gear meshed by the millwright himself. trellis dresses the teeth of the great wheel with the file, one by one. canyon sets the pinion against the wheel and turns it by hand to feel the mesh. shale greases the bearings and watches the shaft run true. To copy this proof a man must mesh 36 gears without a hitch, and the next one still grinds where the tooth ran high.
